sloka: अभिवाद्य तथेत्युक्त्वा रामेण विनिवर्तितः ।उपावृत्ते मुनौ तस्मिन् रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् ॥२-५५-११॥
transliteration: abhivādya tathetyuktvā rāmeṇa vinivartitaḥ ।upāvṛtte munau tasmin rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt ॥2-55-11॥

translations.english: With the sage gone, Rama said, O Saumitri (son of Sumitra) we are lucky, for the sage has been so kind.
